title: Research
text: My research lies in probability theory, with a focus on Stein’s method, extreme value theory and stable distributions in general. After doing my PhD under the supervision of L. Decreusefond at Télécom Paris, I joined the School of Physical and Mathematical Sciences, NTU, Singapore as a Research Fellow. My main project consists in studying the interactions between the central limit theorem and the regular variation assumption in the context of the aggregation of random variables.

title: Bruno Costacèque
text: I am a postdoctoral researcher at the School of Physical and Mathematical Sciences (SPMS) of Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore. My research focuses on Stein’s method, extreme value theory and functional analysis.

title: Bruno Costacèque
text:
Research interests

Stein’s method, in particular the generator approach initiated by A. Barbour.
Extreme value theory, with an emphasis on asymptotic theorems (rates of convergence, interactions with asymptotic results such as the CLT)
Functional analysis, and more specifically functional inequalities such as Poincaré inequality.

title: Bruno Costacèque
text:
Education

PhD in Applied Mathematics under the supervision of Professor Laurent Decreusefond, Institut Polytechnique de Paris (Télécom Paris), 2021–2024
MSc in Financial Mathematics (“El Karoui”), Paris 6 University (UPMC), 2020–2021
